english.title: Possess a prohibited weapon (automatic)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, had in your possession a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..), which was so designed or adapted that two or more missiles could be successively discharged without repeated pressure on the trigger
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(a) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is obsolete, see H6101.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H4305, H4306 and H4326.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
